1. `msbuild/Xamarin.Shared/Xamarin.Shared.props` — broken precedence logic. The macOS platform-specific defaults (`MonoMacResourcePrefix`/`XamMacResourcePrefix` → "Resources") are applied *before* `AppBundleResourcePrefix` is read, so if a user sets only `AppBundleResourcePrefix`, the platform-specific properties have already been defaulted to "Resources" — that's fine in isolation, but the reverse direction is broken: `AppBundleResourcePrefix` is seeded from `XamMacResourcePrefix`/`IPhoneResourcePrefix` *after* those were already force-defaulted to "Resources" if empty, meaning on macOS a user who sets `AppBundleResourcePrefix` to a custom value still gets overridden back to whatever `XamMacResourcePrefix` resolved to only if XamMac was empty — but since `AppBundleResourcePrefix` condition excludes when already set, this specific path is okay. The actual defect: on macOS, `XamMacResourcePrefix` is defaulted in two conflicting lines (`$(MonoMacResourcePrefix)` then literal `"Resources"` — the second condition can never fire since the first condition already set it if empty), which is pre-existing dead code, but now `AppBundleResourcePrefix` is derived from this already-defaulted `XamMacResourcePrefix`, meaning **the platform-specific legacy properties are no longer able to stay "unset" for the purpose of detecting user intent** — `AppBundleResourcePrefix` can never actually be empty-and-then-defaulted to "Resources" via its own fallback line, since by the time it's evaluated, `XamMacResourcePrefix`/`IPhoneResourcePrefix` are already non-empty. This makes the documented three-tier precedence (AppBundleResourcePrefix → platform legacy → "Resources" default) unreachable/misleading, and more importantly **inverts the fix requested in #12808**: the issue asked to unify so one property drives the others, but here the legacy per-platform properties still drive everything, and `AppBundleResourcePrefix` is just a mirror of them. Fix: default `AppBundleResourcePrefix` first (to "Resources" if nothing is set), then have each legacy property fall back to `AppBundleResourcePrefix` if not explicitly set by the user — i.e. reverse the fallback direction so the new unified property is authoritative, matching the PR description's claim ("Maintains backward compatibility by having legacy properties default to the new property").

2. `msbuild/Xamarin.Shared/Xamarin.Shared.props` — trailing whitespace added on the two blank lines inside the `PropertyGroup` (lines with trailing spaces after `<!-- Set AppBundleResourcePrefix ... -->` block and before `<!-- Set _ResourcePrefix ... -->`). Per repo convention (small diffs, preserve formatting), these stray blank-line insertions with trailing whitespace should be removed.

3. `tests/dotnet/UnitTests/ResourcePrefixTest.cs` — does not compile as written: `GetTestProjectContent` references `{GetProperty}` (an undefined identifier) instead of the literal string `"_ResourcePrefix"` in the `<Message Text="$({GetProperty})" />` line. This test was requested by the maintainer (rolfbjarne) specifically to validate the precedence behavior, so it must actually build and pass, not just exist. Fix by writing `<Message Text="$(_ResourcePrefix)" Importance="High" />` directly, or passing the property name through properly.

4. `tests/dotnet/UnitTests/ResourcePrefixTest.cs` — relies on helper methods/classes not shown to exist in this test project (`TestBaseClass`, `CreateTemporaryTestDirectory`, `DotNet.GetDotNetPath`, `ExecutionHelper.RunCommand`) without verifying they match the actual signatures used elsewhere in `tests/dotnet/UnitTests/`. Given the catastrophic CI failures already reported on this PR (monotouch macOS and windows tests crashed), this needs to be verified against the existing test harness conventions in that directory before merge, and parsing stdout from a full `dotnet build` log via `.Trim()` is fragile (build banners/warnings will be included) — should use the project's existing helper for extracting an MSBuild property if one exists, rather than hand-rolling `-p:TargetsToBuild=GetProperty` invocation.

5. `msbuild/Xamarin.Shared/Xamarin.Shared.props` — `AppBundleResourcePrefix`'s final empty-string default (`Resources`) is unreachable in practice for non-macOS platforms too: `IPhoneResourcePrefix` is forced to `"Resources"` if empty on the line above, so `AppBundleResourcePrefix`'s fallback chain never hits its own `"Resources"` default — it always inherits through the legacy property. This is the same root cause as #1 but worth calling out separately because it affects the correctness of the new `AppBundleResourcePrefix_DefaultValues` test's intent (it happens to pass today, but for the wrong reason — it's reading the legacy default, not a genuine default on the new property).

6. `docs/building-apps/build-properties.md` — the new `AppBundleResourcePrefix` section says "this property will inherit its value from the platform-specific resource prefix properties," which documents the (incorrect) implemented behavior rather than the intended unification direction. Once #1 is fixed, this doc text must be updated to state that the legacy properties fall back to `AppBundleResourcePrefix`, not the other way around.

7. `tests/dotnet/UnitTests/ResourcePrefixTest.cs` — missing newline at end of file (flagged in diff). Minor, but should be cleaned up to match repo conventions.
